2014.display: Exact release date unknown; foreword undated.

2015.basis: PIB release states calendar-year 2015 Crime in India was released today. Archived files may incorporate later revisions.
2015.display: Released 2016-08-30 (PIB); corrigendum dated 2016-09-09; archived edition retained.

2011: IPC Table 1.14 supplies 30 columns; SLL and a comparable aggregate of crimes against women are not supplied by this selected table and remain null.
Printed labels Molestation (354) and Sexual Harassment (509) are retained. Census 2011 provisional population underlies published rates; no rates are reconstructed.
2012: Same 17-unit IPC layout; 354/509 header wording changes to assault on women/insult to modesty. No boundary equivalence is inferred.
SLL and comparable crimes-against-women aggregate are not supplied by this selected table and remain null. Additional multi-year catalogues are discovery leads, not extracted substitutes.
2013: 18 reporting units: METRO RAIL appears separately in 2013, compared with 17 units in 2011-2012.
Criminal Law (Amendment) Act 2013 may affect offence coverage; equal IPC section labels do not prove unchanged legal definitions across 2012/2013.
Published rate denominators for women and other segments change; staged values are counts only. SLL and comparable women aggregate absent from selected IPC table remain null.
2014: NCRB revised proformae, added heads and changed sections. 19 units replace the earlier 17/18-unit lists; do not treat this as a stable district panel.
Revised Criminal Trespass/Burglary is distinct from old Burglary. Women basket expands to suicide abetment and domestic violence; women totals are not additive to IPC/SLL.
2015: 19 reporting units as printed; unit names alone do not establish boundary continuity with 2014 or 2016 onward.
Retain revised offence heads, separate women aggregate versus women-victim total, and source corrigendum. Prior categories are not mechanically backfilled.

reuse_terms.assessment: 2012 foreword explicitly permits free downloading from the NCRB website. No explicit open-data redistribution licence was established for these direct-hosted files; attribution and permission/terms review are required before public redistribution.

Archived site footer states All Rights Reserved. No explicit open-data licence for the annual PDFs or statistics was established. Retain provenance; review permission/terms before public redistribution.

discovery_scope.ncrb: Official year indexes, main tables and additional tables for each 2011-2015 year. Early multi-year women/IPC additional links recorded in discovery pages but not substituted for original-year IPC sources. No early district SLL/CAW aggregate is claimed unavailable globally.
discovery_scope.traffic: Official annual-report landing page and linked 2015 chapters; official statistics; targeted official-domain searches for 2011-2014. Original 2011-2014 annual-report PDFs not located, not proof of non-publication.
discovery_scope.not_collected: All-India raw source files are archived, but only Delhi rows are extracted. Other offence families, investigation/trial outcomes, rates and population denominators are outside this initial staged extract.
